name: 48335 · Farmingtn Hls, MI
findings: ZIP 48335 (Farmingtn Hls) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48335 (Farmingtn Hls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
